name: Buildfire
description: Buildfire helps app owners manage their Buildfire apps directly from Claude. Users can list accessible apps, inspect installed features, search and create users, assign or remove tags, review app and plugin analytics, inspect plugin memory, find push notification groups, and schedule push notifications with confirmation-oriented dry runs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Buildfire to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Buildfire to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.buildfire.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Buildfire MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buildfire lists 18 MCP tools, including assign_user_tags, create_user, get_app_analytics_bulk, get_app_users_count, get_plugin_instance_analytics_daily, get_tag_users_count, list_app_analytics_events, list_app_features, list_apps, list_plugin_instance_analytics_events, list_push_notifications_app_groups, and list_users.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Buildfire?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Buildfire in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Buildfire requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Buildfire is developed by Buildfire. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
